subject: Using RStan when Rtools is installed in a different folder

messages.author: 9380fccf66859560
messages.subject: Using RStan when Rtools is installed in a different folder
parts:
Hello all,

So, I have been using Stan for a while now, but today I had to install it in a new machine that has Rtools installed within R's main folder: "C:/R/Rtools".

Naturally, when I try to compile Stan code through R, I get the following error message:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! C:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++: not found

Is there a way through which I could redirect Stan to look for Rtools in the non-standard folder where it is installed?

Thanks for your time.

Martina Andrews

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Using RStan when Rtools is installed in a different folder
parts:
Hi Martina,

Yes, you'll need to edit your path. A google search for "edit path windows" will pull up step-by-step instructions. You might also want to include the version of Windows you're on for more specific instructions.


Daniel
